dogecoin.text:
@hereisMichaelM Well, 280 characters doesn't give me a lot to work with, Michael 😂
I'm happy people are making money off of Dogecoin right now. I think it could hit $1. But I don't think it's a smart long-term investment.

In light of all the crypto interest, I have to comment:

#Dogecoin is just a fad.
#Bitcoin  is old, but a solid investment.
#Ethereum is the future, has the most potential for innovation & growth.

My personal takes based on what I've researched.
